entities.name: diner seated at the west table of the riverside terrace
entities.what: Man seated at the west end of the terrace hall on stilts over the river, in a light robe with a dark cap or hair knot, turned east toward the man across the table (S2.prop.terrace_table_23125) with his arms held forward; only his upper body shows above the balustrade. A diner.
entities.vis: part: lower body behind the terrace's balustrade
entities.note: Head u 23072-23090, v 315-325; robe down to the balustrade's top rail at v ~368. Foot est from a seated height of ~57 px (the standing man at the eatery, S2.fig.eatery_man_23642, is 72 px at foot v 398). Floor line straight below the figure: the hall's front sill (under the decorated panel) at v ~440; the stilts reach the shore at about v 490 (est). Seat hidden. A light shape at u 23105-23127, v 312-322 above B's head may be his raised hand with a cup (or B's hat).

entities.name: diner with his back to the viewer at the terrace's west table
entities.what: Man seated on the near (south) side of the west table in the terrace hall, his back to the viewer, facing north-west toward the diner S2.fig.terrace_diner_w_23083; dark hair or cap, light robe. A light shape just above his head is either a raised hand with a cup (his or the other diner's) or a hat. A diner.
entities.vis: part: seen from behind, lower body behind the balustrade
entities.note: Dark head u 23110-23123, v 328-342 (head top 328; 313 if the light shape above is his hat). Foot est from a seated height of ~55 px. Floor front sill straight below at v ~442, shore ~490 (est).

entities.name: unclear shape beside the west table: a third diner or a draped cloth
entities.what: Between the diner with his back to the viewer and the hall's middle post, a fan of robe-like folds (u 23130-23167, v 342-372) with a small dark mark at about (23145, 345): either a third diner hunched or reclining with his back to the viewer, or a cloth or folded object draped on a bench.
entities.vis: part: behind the balustrade and the middle post
entities.note: BOTH READINGS: the restyle paints a white-robed person here; on the scan no dark head as clear as the other diners' (A, B, D) shows, only folds radiating from a point. Kept with conf low; the second pass may retire it as cloth. If a figure, it is small (head to rail ~30 px).

entities.name: diner leaning east over the terrace's balustrade
entities.what: Man in a light robe with dark hair or a dark cap, seen from behind, leaning forward toward the east over the balustrade or a table with one long sleeve stretched east to about (23255, 362); possibly reclining on his side. A diner in the middle of the terrace hall, east of its middle post.
entities.vis: part: lower body behind the balustrade
entities.note: Head u 23207-23224, v 338-349; body and arm u 23203-23260, v 348-377. The restyle splits this into two people (a dark-haired man and a white-robed man reclining east of him at u 23230-23260): the scan has one head. Facing uncertain (back of the head or a cap). Floor front sill straight below at v ~448, shore ~492 (est).

entities.name: diner alone in the terrace's gabled east pavilion
entities.what: Man in a light robe with a dark cap seated alone in the gabled east pavilion of the terrace building, facing west, his hands on a table or sill in front of him (S2.prop.pavilion_table_23392); seen from the chest up behind the pavilion's lattice railing. A diner.
entities.vis: part: lower body behind the table/sill and the lattice railing
entities.note: Head u 23380-23397, v 325-334; robe to v ~362 where the table edge crosses. Seated or standing behind a sill: seated read from the 37 px above the edge. The pavilion's lattice balcony in front: top v ~367-375, bottom rail v ~432-445; its posts reach the ground or shore at v ~470-495 (est). The restyle adds a small second figure at u 23300-23315 (v 335-350): not on the scan.

entities.name: stout man seated among the open-air eatery's tables
entities.what: Stout man in a light long robe with a dark topknot or cap, seated on the east end of the bench S2.prop.eatery_bench_23612 beside the table S2.prop.eatery_table_23683 under the eatery's shelter, body toward the viewer, arms held in front of him (perhaps holding a bowl): a customer, or the eatery's keeper resting.
entities.note: Feet u 23634-23648, v 395-399; head u 23640-23657, v 326-337. Painted height 72 px at foot v 398 (the trackers at v ~390 are ~99 px: the painter's sizes vary). His hips are level with the bench top (v ~370), so a seated reading (on the bench's east end, lower legs 26 px) is possible; standing chosen from the 40 px table height next to him. The restyle surrounds him with 3-4 more people (one in red, one in blue) at u 23660-23720: the scan has only him and the tables' edges and posts. Second pass: pose standing -> seated (conf med). He is 72 px from head top (v 326) to feet (v 398), with the torso about 45 px down to the bench top (v ~368-376) and only about 23 px of lower leg below it, the proportions of a seated man. Standing men nearby are far taller at similar or higher foot v: S2.fig.hat_walker_24004 109 px at v 373, S2.fig.eatery_man_standing_23918 92 px at v 301; a standing man at v 398 would be about 100-110 px, and 72 px is about 0.7 of that, as for the seated shop men (59-65 px at v 180-192). Foot unchanged (his feet at u 23634-23648, v 395-399). Support stays ground (the bench is a prop, named here). S2.fig.terrace_diner_w_23083's note uses him as a standing 72 px reference for the diners' seated height (57 px); seated, he suggests the diners' feet may sit 10-15 px lower than their est, within the est.

entities.name: table at the terrace's west end
entities.what: Table between the two diners at the west end of the terrace hall; its far edge shows as a bar at v ~330-342 from u 23095 to 23150 with small marks on it (dishes or cups?); its near edge and legs are hidden by the diner with his back to the viewer and the balustrade.
entities.vis: part: near half hidden by a diner and the balustrade
entities.note: Base est under the middle of the visible top. Top width ~55 px.

entities.name: table with a light top in the terrace hall's east part
entities.what: Rectangular table with a light-coloured top seen from above, standing unattended in the east part of the terrace hall just west of the post at the pavilion's corner; legs hidden by the balustrade.
entities.note: Top u 23274-23324, v 349-381 (back edge ~349, front edge ~369-381). SCALE CUE: top ~50 px long. Floor front sill straight below at v ~454.

entities.name: round object east of the terrace's middle post
entities.what: A loop-shaped object just east of the hall's middle post: a cloth bundle, a basket or a wine jar on the floor or a bench.
entities.note: Strokes u 23177-23198, v 350-367. The restyle muddles it into the diners; it shows no head. Could be part of the diner S2.fig.terrace_figure_unclear_23148 (both readings).

entities.name: angular furniture at the back of the terrace hall
entities.what: Angular strokes at the back of the hall north of the leaning diner: the back and arm of a chair or a stool, or a small table seen end-on.
entities.note: Strokes u 23234-23264, v 317-329 ('Z' and a hook shape), with vertical members at u 23274-23290, v 331-353 that may be the table S2.prop.terrace_table_23298's far legs. Could also be window bars in the hall's back wall (structures_w).

entities.name: table (or sill) in front of the pavilion diner
entities.what: A straight edge in front of the diner in the gabled east pavilion, on which his hands rest: a small table, or the pavilion's inner sill.
entities.vis: part: below the edge hidden by the lattice railing
entities.note: Edge from (23363, 367) to (23417, 357). If it is a sill it belongs to the building (structures_w).

entities.name: bench at the eatery's west end
entities.what: Long wooden bench under the open-air eatery's shelter, west of the standing man; two legs show at its west end.
entities.vis: part: east end behind the standing man
entities.note: Top from (23594, 366) to (23630, 370); legs at u ~23596 and ~23606 down to v ~390. Could be a low table. A second top edge just behind it at v ~350-362 (u 23600-23640) may be a table it serves.

entities.name: table east of the standing man at the eatery
entities.what: Wooden table under the eatery's shelter, its top sloping up east from the standing man; legs at both ends.
entities.note: Top from (23658, 350) to (23708, 340); legs at u ~23660, ~23681 and ~23705 down to v ~385-392. SCALE CUE: table height ~40 px (top front edge v ~350 to feet v ~390) beside a 72 px man.

entities.name: long table or counter at the back of the eatery
entities.what: A long table or counter at the back of the eatery behind the standing man, parallel bars of its top and rail.
entities.vis: part: behind the man and the front tables
entities.note: Top bars u 23636-23704, v 305-315; legs not clear. Could be the shelter's rail (structures_w).

entities.name: dark object on a stand at the back of the eatery
entities.what: A dark, cross-hatched mass on a stand at the back of the eatery: a stack of steamers or jars on a rack, or a stove.
entities.note: Mass u 23672-23702, v 277-302, with a curl at (23703, 285). The restyle paints blue pots on a shelf here. Too large for a head at this scale (heads here are 12-15 px).

entities.name: dark object behind the eatery's panelled screen
entities.what: A small dark upright shape behind the panelled screen at the eatery's west end: a hanging lamp or pot, or a jar on a shelf.
entities.vis: part: behind the screen's top rail
entities.note: Dark smudge u 23570-23578, v 290-305, with grid-like strokes (shelving or stacked boards) round it at u 23505-23590, v 275-330. The restyle paints a round pot or lantern with a handle here. If it hangs from the shelter it belongs to the building (structures_w). Too short for a person (no body shows down to the screen's rail at v ~335).

entities.name: the diners on the riverside terrace
entities.what: Diners in the open hall on stilts over the river beside 豪华客船's mooring: two men at a table at the west end (one with his back to the viewer), an unclear third shape beside them, one man leaning east over the balustrade, a free table, and one man alone in the gabled east pavilion.
entities.note: The terrace building and its balustrades, stilts and pavilion are structures_w's; support 'terrace floor: S2.bld.river_terrace_23250' (structures_w's terrace; the merge wrote the ID). 豪华客船 (river_w2) lies just south of the stilts.
